note: Material Icons provides a material_icons field type (columns icon/family/classes) with a matching widget (settings allow_style/default_style/allow_classes) and formatter (theme material_icon -> {icon}), plus a CKEditor 5 button. Which icon font families load site-wide is controlled by material_icons.settings -> families (default ['baseline']). Medium cases read known values (an enabled families list; a widget default_style on a created field). Hard cases create a material_icons field on Article (field_mi_icon) and enable extra families. All fields are namespaced (field_mi_*), and scripts restore the shipped families default ['baseline'] explicitly. No drush cr (config/entity reads are live) to avoid an unrelated shared-site group-module cache-rebuild fault.

evals.prompt: The Drupal module material_icons provides a field type for icons. What is the field type's id, what three pieces of data does it store, and what HTML does its formatter output for one icon?
evals.expected_output: Field type id material_icons stores icon (name), family (style), and classes. Its formatter themes each value with the material_icon template as {icon}.

evals.prompt: How do I let editors insert Material Icons into rich text with CKEditor 5 using the material_icons module?
evals.expected_output: In Text formats and editors, configure a CKEditor 5 format and drag the 'Material Icons' button into the Active toolbar (ensure <span class> is allowed). The button opens the icon-picker dialog and inserts a <span> with the icon classes.

evals.prompt: Which configuration object and key control the Material Icons font styles (families) that get loaded on every page, and what is the shipped default?
evals.expected_output: material_icons.settings -> families (a list of family keys). The shipped default is ['baseline'] (Material Icons Filled). Each enabled family is attached site-wide as an external Google Fonts stylesheet.

evals.prompt: On this site, more than one Material Icons font family has been enabled. Inspect the live material_icons configuration and list the enabled families.

The Article content type has a Material Icons field whose widget has been configured with a specific default icon style. Inspect the live default form display for Article and state the widget's configured default style.
evals.expected_output: The field_mi_known widget has default_style = 'outlined' in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default under content.field_mi_known.settings.default_style.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a Material Icons field named field_mi_icon to the Article content type (using the material_icons field type). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A field storage node.field_mi_icon of type material_icons exists and is attached to the article bundle (FieldConfig node.article.field_mi_icon).

evals.prompt: On this site, enable the 'Outlined' and 'Sharp' Material Icons families (in addition to the default Filled/baseline) so those style packs load on the pages. Apply the change to the live site.
